lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\TermsOfService\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
10 uses of the private API of the server in 4 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

lines: 1 connection to a legacy hook of the server. A hook the server removed is never emitted, and the listener never runs; the typed events of OCP\EventDispatcher replace the hooks.
OCP\Util::connectHook() is deprecated since Nextcloud 21: use \OCP\EventDispatcher\IEventDispatcher::addListener. ocp-deprecated leaves these calls to this finding.

boot() registers a listener or takes a service from the container in 6 places. boot() runs once for every process of the server, so each of them is built on every request. registerEventListener() in register() builds a listener only when its event fires.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
